pipeline.title: Osivax focuses on combo strategy for flu vaccine after phase 2 fail
pipeline.summary: Osivax has been forced to narrow the strategy for its influenza vaccine after the shot failed a phase 2b study.

pipeline.title: Vanda pauses social anxiety program after ex-Novartis asset flunks phase 3 study
pipeline.summary: A phase 3 trial of Vanda Pharmaceuticals’ social anxiety disorder drug candidate has missed its primary endpoint, prompting the company to put the program on hold.

pipeline.title: FDA clears ImmunityBio’s Anktiva expansion in bladder cancer after regulatory whiplash
pipeline.summary: To expand Anktiva’s label, the FDA adopted a new approach to how it evaluates treatments for BCG-unresponsive NMIBC. The new regulatory path essentially allowed ImmunityBio to bypass an expensive randomized phase 3 trial that competitor Johnson & Johnson is currently forced t

pipeline.title: Ultragenyx makes swift $413M return on FDA review vouchers after summer of gene therapy nods
pipeline.summary: Hot off a pair of key FDA approvals this summer, rare disease specialist Ultragenyx has wasted little time cashing in on the priority review vouchers it earned from the green lights.

pipeline.title: Verastem CEO claims RAS drug has 'set a new benchmark' for tricky cancer in early readout
pipeline.summary: Verastem Oncology's decision to refocus its R&D efforts on its KRAS inhibitor appears to be paying off, at least based on initial data from a phase 1/2 trial.

pipeline.title: Deep-pocketed Verdiva axes GLP-1 switching trial over ‘market evolution’
pipeline.summary: Verdiva Bio has scrapped a phase 2 trial of its once-weekly oral GLP-1 drug candidate VRB-101, pulling the plug the year after launching with $410 million.

pipeline.title: Biomea posts phase 1 data to pitch oral GLP-1 to potential partners, but investors appear unconvinced
pipeline.summary: Biomea Fusion has shared phase 1 data on its oral GLP-1 prospect, shedding light on a small molecule designed to balance efficacy and gastrointestinal tolerability. Management hailed the data as a launchpad for talks with potential partners, but investors drove down the share pri

pipeline.title: Merck KGaA spinout iOnctura touts PI3K delta inhibitor in metastatic eye cancer
pipeline.summary: iOnctura’s PI3K delta inhibitor shows promise in phase 1 study in patients with mostly pre-treated metastatic melanoma.

pipeline.title: IQVIA, Veeva expand on existing partnership for speedier clinical trials
pipeline.summary: Clinical research giant IQVIA and cloud system provider Veeva Systems have expanded their partnership to further increase trial speed and efficiency.

pipeline.title: WCG unveils AI-powered solution to accelerate clinical trial kickoffs
pipeline.summary: WCG, a clinical trials solutions provider, is launching an AI-powered program dubbed Activation Intelligence to help study sites accelerate clinical trial start-up.

pipeline.title: Syndax shares fall 17% after calling it quits on Niktimvo fibrosis program
pipeline.summary: Syndax and Incyte are cutting their idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis program short after a phase 2 trial failed to meet its primary endpoint. The drugmakers plan to refocus on expanding the study drug Niktimvo's label for its original indication, graft-versus-host disease.

pipeline.title: BioNTech’s mRNA cancer vaccine fails phase 3 test, significantly denting analysts’ confidence
pipeline.summary: A phase 2/3 clinical trial of BioNTech’s mRNA cancer immunotherapy BNT113 has missed one of its dual primary endpoints. But with immature overall survival data offering a path to redemption, the German biotech is continuing to track patients in the metastatic head and neck cancer

pipeline.title: Mirum on its way to 3rd rare liver indication for Livmarli
pipeline.summary: Livmarli significantly improved severe itching caused by rare liver diseases. With the phase 3 win in hand, Mirum is looking for a third indication from the FDA early next year.

pipeline.title: Regulatory tracker: Pierre Fabre's Ebvallo takes 3rd run at FDA approval
pipeline.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.

pipeline.title: OrbiMed’s largest-ever Asian fund contributes to $3B war chest
pipeline.summary: OrbiMed has raised $3 billion to place a fresh round of bets on biotechs and life sciences companies in the U.S., Europe and Asia.

pipeline.title: Isotope supplier NorthStar continues rise with partnership to tee up China radiopharmaceutical filings
pipeline.summary: As the momentum continues to pick up at NorthStar Medical Technologies, the radioisotope producer is strengthening ties in China, in a move that helps put its actinium-225 supplies on the map for local radiopharmaceutical filings.

pipeline.title: Compass puts treatment-resistant depression on the map with first awareness day
pipeline.summary: Compass Pathways has partnered with mental health organizations on the first-ever awareness day for treatment-resistant depression.

pipeline.title: Rebranded Galapagos finally finds buyer for unwanted cell therapy pipeline
pipeline.summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics—the new name for Belgium’s Galapagos Therapeutics—has found a buyer for its unwanted cell therapy pipeline.

pipeline.title: AstraZeneca inks $1.5B insitro deal for AI-enabled target discovery of liver, heart disease drugs
pipeline.summary: AstraZeneca is paying insitro $40 million upfront to find novel drug targets for liver and heart diseases using artificial intelligence.

pipeline.title: Iambic goes public with $150M IPO to accelerate clinical development of oncology pipeline
pipeline.summary: Iambic Therapeutics’ IPO came in dead on target, bringing in $150 million for the AI biotech to fuel the clinical development of its oncology pipeline.

pipeline.title: Iambic, an AI drug discovery specialist, banks $150M in an IPO
pipeline.summary: Part of a wave of young biotechs employing AI to accelerate research, the company claimed in regulatory filings that its approach has the potential to “disrupt legacy drug discovery paradigms.”

pipeline.title: Gilead puts a timely spotlight on HIV prevention in Latino communities with 'Ahorita Mismo' campaign
pipeline.summary: Gilead's “Ahorita Mismo (Right Now!)” stars two popular Latino creators in a call-in podcast themed spot looking to spark conversations around HIV prevention.

pipeline.title: Experimental Arrowhead RNAi drug hints at Alzheimer’s benefit
pipeline.summary: In a first, a subcutaneously administered RNA interference medicine crossed into the brain and plummeted levels of a protein implicated in the disease.

pipeline.title: Verastem cancer drug shows early promise in small study
pipeline.summary: Wall Street analysts believe Verastem’s drug to now be “competitive” in what’s quickly become one of the most active and crowded areas of oncology research.

pipeline.title: CVS to pay $315M to settle opioid prescribing allegations
pipeline.summary: Prosecutors say the company filled unnecessary prescriptions that fueled the opioid epidemic. A spokesperson for CVS said the company admitted to no wrongdoing and “strongly disagreed” with the case’s claims.

pipeline.title: United lands 'clear-cut win' as Liquidia agrees to $380M settlement in Tyvaso patent infringement saga
pipeline.summary: With a years-long patent dispute between the two drugmakers finally put to bed—complete with a hefty settlement payout—United Therapeutics has clinched what one analyst calls a “clear-cut win” over lung disease rival Liquidia Technologies.

pipeline.title: AbbVie marks calendar for ‘Time For Treks’ in National Park Foundation, CLL Society partnership
pipeline.summary: AbbVie's “Time For Treks” brings the chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) community together for an outdoor gathering at Cabrillo National Monument, San Diego, on Oct. 17.

pipeline.title: Galderma bulks up dermatology portfolio with $1.5B acquisition of Zo Skin Health
pipeline.summary: Expanding its presence in dermatology, Cetaphil maker Galderma has agreed to acquire professional skincare shop Zo Skin Health for $1.5 billion.

pipeline.title: J&J earnings set ‘negative tone’; Shkreli vs. the FTC
pipeline.summary: A 6% sell-off in J&J shares was viewed by one analyst as emblematic of broader market volatility. Elsewhere, Gilead is collaborating with Vir and a biotech’s bid for a product expansion fell short.

pipeline.title: FTC seeks sanctions against Martin Shkreli over alleged pharma ban violations
pipeline.summary: The FTC alleges that “Pharma Bro” Martin Shkreli flagrantly traded pharmaceutical stocks on social media for three years, violating his lifetime ban from the industry.

pipeline.title: NantWorks' Soon-Shiong puts chips behind manufacturing disruptors in new rounds for Prolific Machines, Multiply Labs
pipeline.summary: With demand for advanced manufacturing solutions mounting across the industry, the moment is ripe to capitalize on investor interest and build out toward a potential production paradigm shift.

pipeline.title: Why OMass’ $310M series C marks ‘fantastic milestone’ on journey to become ‘Britain’s Big Biotech’
pipeline.summary: When Fierce last caught up with OMass Therapeutics’ CEO Ros Deegan, it was hard not to be impressed by the company’s ambition.

pipeline.title: Sanofi dodges EU fine over alleged disparagement of CSL flu vaccine
pipeline.summary: Sanofi has avoided a European Union fine after antitrust regulators accepted its commitments to address the alleged disparagement of CSL Seqirus’ rival flu vaccine.

pipeline.title: GSK to lay off over 1,200 roles in Belgium as cost-saving program picks up steam
pipeline.summary: Up to 1,217 GSK employees in Belgium are at risk of losing their jobs as the Big Pharma rolls out its global cost-saving plans.

pipeline.title: Zealand inks $1.2B Generate pact to add multispecific proteins to obesity pipeline
pipeline.summary: Zealand Pharma is paying Generate Biomedicines $30 million upfront to collaborate on multispecific drug candidates for metabolic diseases. Milestones could bring the total value of the deal above $1 billion.

pipeline.title: Agilent spends $240M upfront to buy digital pathology specialist Proscia
pipeline.summary: Agilent Technologies is buying up the digital pathology software company Proscia in an all-cash transaction valued at $240 million with an additional $30 million on the cards for future performance milestones.

pipeline.title: Vir CEO sees ‘opportunity to do more deals’ after striking $1.9B Gilead pact for dual-masked TCEs
pipeline.summary: Looking to expand its oncology portfolio, Gilead has tapped Vir Biotechnology’s masked T-cell engager tech in a potential $1.9 billion biobucks deal.

pipeline.title: Decreasing process variability in fluid management systems
pipeline.summary: Discover why flow paths, tubing and connectors may limit your bioprocess performance

pipeline.title: Another Paragon spinout goes public through reverse merger
pipeline.summary: One lawyer involved noted how it's yet another example of Paragon and key investor Fairmount — which have helped transform the reputation for reverse mergers — quickly executing on a complicated deal.

pipeline.title: Stryker pens deal with CMR Surgical to advance robotic-assisted surgery
pipeline.summary: Stryker will funnel around $400 million (£300 million) in a “strategic” investment in CMR Surgical and its robot surgery tech.

pipeline.title: BioNTech mRNA cancer immunotherapy misses first objective in key study
pipeline.summary: An early data check showed the shot didn’t delay tumor progression in a form of head and neck cancer, though BioNTech is holding out hope it might eventually extend survival.

pipeline.title: Roche extends China deal streak with $1B pact for RNAi obesity drug
pipeline.summary: An alliance with Rona Therapeutics adds to a particularly active stretch for Roche and makes the company the latest to bet on medicines that can lower levels of “visceral” fat.

pipeline.title: J&J’s new pharma chief expects Icotyde’s psoriasis launch momentum to repeat across indications
pipeline.summary: As Johnson & Johnson rode out 2026’s third quarter, leveraging its pharmaceutical segment to navigate medtech headwinds, much of the company’s near-term excitement has turned to IL-23 pill Icotyde.

pipeline.title: BARDA awards Kaléo $96M contract to deploy auto-injector for chemical threat preparedness
pipeline.summary: Drug-device maker Kaléo has secured a federal contract worth $96.1 million to bolster U.S. biodefense.

pipeline.title: Biotech builder Paragon imports Apogee's top brass after AbbVie buyout
pipeline.summary: It’s been a busy morning for Paragon Labs. In addition to bringing over much of the leadership team from AbbVie-acquired Apogee Therapeutics, Paragon has overseen a reverse merger to take its hypertension-focused spinout Velaris Therapeutics public.

pipeline.title: UCB fashions ‘Wear It Out’ project with empowering t-shirts, community for inflammatory disease patients
pipeline.summary: The t-shirts let those with hidradenitis suppurativa (HS), plaque psoriasis and psoriatic arthritis (PsA) reclaim clothes they may avoid due to their disease.

pipeline.title: Roche inks $1.2B deal with China's Rona to enter emerging ALK7 obesity race
pipeline.summary: Roche has committed $100 million in upfront and near-term payments to license Rona Therapeutics’ ALK7 drug candidate, joining Alnylam, Arrowhead, GSK and Novo Nordisk in an emerging obesity niche.

pipeline.title: Galderma sculpts new narrative around menopausal skin changes to fill awareness gap
pipeline.summary: One in two women is unaware that hormonal fluctuations during perimenopause and menopause can affect their skin, a Galderma survey found.

pipeline.title: Nurix drops one BTK degrader as momentum builds behind Roche-partnered option
pipeline.summary: Nurix’s BTK degrader zelebrudomide may have survived a clinical hold in recent years, but that hasn’t stopped the California biotech from dropping the cancer drug.

pipeline.title: Insulet’s Omnipod Discover platform sees full market release in US
pipeline.summary: Insulet Corporation has announced the U.S. full market release of Omnipod Discover, a web-based data platform designed for Omnipod 5.

pipeline.title: First Tracks climbs on ‘impressive’ celiac study data
pipeline.summary: Initial study findings strengthened some analysts’ belief that First Tracks’ drug, one of a few in development aimed at the protein CD122, might have “pipeline-in-a-product” potential.

pipeline.title: ARPA-H program manager talks 'first-shoring' philosophy behind $125M RNA manufacturing network challenge
pipeline.summary: Rather than another instance of on-shoring enthusiasm, ARPA-H’s personalized RNA drug production network project should be viewed as more akin to a “first-shoring program,” said John Schiel, Ph.D., program manager for GIVE at ARPA-H.

pipeline.title: Invenra deals patient perspectives into the ADC game with custom card deck
pipeline.summary: Invenra has created playing cards featuring artwork by people affected by cancer as it seeks biopharma buy-in for its antibody-drug conjugate service.

pipeline.title: Asahi Kasei buyout yields novel FDA herpes nod in immunocompromised patients
pipeline.summary: Roughly half a year after the close of its deal to acquire Bayer spinout AiCurus, Asahi Kasei’s $920 million bet has paid off with an FDA green light.

pipeline.title: Bausch + Lomb names Appio interim CEO as Saunders hits the exit again
pipeline.summary: Less than four years after returning to Bausch + Lomb to lead the eye health company following its split from Bausch Health, Brent Saunders is hitting the exit once again, as analysts call the transition a surprise.

pipeline.title: Par Health recalls more IV bags over cellulose risk weeks after similar action
pipeline.summary: Par Health issued a voluntary recall of two lots of the IV barbiturate Brevital sodium that may be tainted with cellulose.

pipeline.title: UCB’s Bimzelx takes top drug ad spending spot as streaming data come to the fore
pipeline.summary: UCB’s immunology drug Bimzelx has once again become the highest-ranked drug in iSpot.TV’s pharma ad spending league, topping the charts for September.

pipeline.title: Pfizer pens $500M Enodia pact to join Lilly in emerging protein degrader field
pipeline.summary: Pfizer has followed Eli Lilly into the Sec61 space, inking a $500 million deal with Enodia Therapeutics days after its Big Pharma peer formed an $870 million pact with Gate Bioscience.

pipeline.title: Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker '26: Soufflé cooks up $135M; Matchpoint makes $150M
pipeline.summary: The Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker records venture capital rounds of $50 million or more secured by biotechs.
